title: Human Trafficking Prevention Act of 2022
official_summary:
Human Trafficking Prevention Act of 2022

This act requires the posting of contact information of the national human trafficking hotline in specific places.

Specifically, the information must be posted

  • in a visible place in all federal buildings;
  • in the restrooms of each U.S. aircraft, airport, over-the-road bus, bus station, passenger train, and passenger railroad station; and
  • at each port of entry.

summary.headline: Requires posting of the national human trafficking hotline's contact information in federal buildings and in certain transportation locations.
summary.what_it_does: This law requires that the contact information for the national human trafficking hotline be posted in a visible place in all federal buildings. It also requires the information to be posted in restrooms on U.S. aircraft, at airports, on over-the-road buses, at bus stations, on passenger trains, and at passenger railroad stations. The information must also be posted at each port of entry.

who_it_affects.group: Travelers using airports, buses, trains, and train stations
who_it_affects.how: They will see hotline contact information posted in restrooms and at stations where they travel.

who_it_affects.group: Operators of U.S. aircraft, buses, and passenger trains
who_it_affects.how: They must make sure the hotline information is posted in the restrooms of their vehicles.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and employees working in federal buildings
who_it_affects.how: They must post the hotline contact information in a visible place inside federal buildings.

who_it_affects.group: People entering the U.S. at ports of entry
who_it_affects.how: They will find hotline contact information posted at border crossings and similar entry points.
